finding.name: Improper Authentication
finding.sink_code: var result = await _signInManager.PasswordSignInAsync(model.UserName, model.Password, model.RememberMe, lockoutOnFailure: false);
finding.summary: login action calls SignInManager.PasswordSignInAsync with lockoutOnFailure explicitly set to false, disabling ASP.NET Core Identity's account lockout and permitting unlimited password guesses against an account
